title: The golden-ratio characterization by constant range
statement:
Let $\alpha>0$ be irrational, let $f_\alpha$ be the function defined in the paper, and let $\varphi$ denote the golden ratio. **The golden-ratio range conjecture.**

$$
\operatorname{Range}(f_\alpha)=\{1\}\qquad\Longleftrightarrow\qquad\alpha=\varphi.
$$

The authors state that the golden ratio is the only positive irrational parameter for which they encountered a constant function in their explorations. The equivalence is conjectural and unproved.
references:
**3 papers in this index state this conjecture** (2014–2025). The statement above is taken from the most recent of them; the others are [arXiv:1610.09725](https://arxiv.org/abs/1610.09725), [arXiv:1403.2987](https://arxiv.org/abs/1403.2987).

Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2507.14244

Status: no resolution is reported in the source (as of July 2025).
source_name: Árpád Bényi and Branko Ćurgus, “Floor, ceiling and the space between”, arXiv:2507.14244 (2025).
